predecessors.name: Kingdom of Hungary
predecessors.text: the northern and western parts of the country: Slovakia and western Transdanubia

successors.name: Habsburg monarchy
successors.text: the whole kingdom reunited after Karlowitz (the Banat stayed Ottoman until 1718)

ledger.x: 24 February 1538: the Treaty of Nagyvárad gives the Habsburgs Royal Hungary.
1552: the Ottoman northern expansion ('In 1552 the eyalet was expanded with new territories in the North').
1593: the Long Turkish War opens ('29 July 1593'); the first ground fought over is Veszprém and Várpalota (October 1593).
1594: 'Ottomans captured Győr and Komárom'.
1595: 'Mansfeld's Christian forces captured Esztergom and Visegrád on the Danube'.
1596: 'Ottomans conquered Eger' (Mezőkeresztes, 24-26 October 1596).
1598: 'Habsburg forces retook Győr and Komárom'.

1600: the Ottoman Kanije eyalet is set up around Nagykanizsa ('Kanije (1600)'); the Long Turkish War page has the Habsburg siege of Nagykanizsa failing in 1601 and the Ottomans 'kept Eger and Kanizsa' in 1606.
11 November 1606: Zsitvatorok.
11 November 1606: Zsitvatorok ends the Long Turkish War; 'The war was indecisive, with little territory changing hands'.
1663: the Austro-Turkish War reaches Slovakia: the Ottoman army 'in September conquered the town of' Érsekújvár (Nové Zámky).
September 1663: Nové Zámky (Érsekújvár) falls to the Ottomans.
10 August 1664: the Peace of Vasvár; the Habsburgs recognise Ottoman control of 'Transylvania, Nagyvárad, and Érsekújvár'.
1683: the Great Turkish War; the Ottomans 'laid siege to Vienna on 14 July 1683'.
October 1683: 'Victory at Párkány in October 1683 led to Esztergom surrendering after a short siege.'
1685: 'Eperies, Kaschau and Tokaj fell soon afterwards.
19 August 1685: 'Érsekújvár (Nové Zámky) fell on 19 August' to the imperial forces.
2 September 1686: Buda is retaken after 78 days; it had been Ottoman since 1541.
1687-1691: bridging.
January 1699: the Treaty of Karlowitz: 'The Ottomans ceded most of Hungary, Transylvania and Slavonia'.
January 1699: the divided kingdom ends.

wars.name: Hungarian succession war between Ferdinand I and John Zápolya
wars.outcome: The country 'was ruled by two crowned kings' after Mohács; the Treaty of Nagyvárad of 24 February 1538 gave the Habsburgs western Hungary.

wars.name: Long Turkish War
wars.outcome: Indecisive: the Ottomans kept Eger and Kanizsa, the Habsburgs got Vác; peace of Zsitvatorok on 11 November 1606; Bocskai rose in 1604-1606.

wars.name: Austro-Turkish War (1663-1664)
wars.outcome: The Ottomans took Nové Zámky in September 1663 and kept it at Vasvár on 10 August 1664.

wars.name: Great Turkish War
wars.outcome: The Holy League takes Esztergom (1683), Nové Zámky (1685), Buda (2 September 1686); Slankamen (1691); Karlowitz in January 1699.

certainty.note: The division line was a chain of fortresses, not a surveyed boundary; the treaties of 1606 and 1664 name fortresses (Vác, Eger, Kanizsa, Nové Zámky).
